slides.text:
Samsung to outsource all of its DRAM
Samsung to outsource all of its DRAM manufacturing and focus on HBM production

The AI race is heating up, and so is the demand for hardware required to support it.
That's why companies that produce HBM memory chips like Samsung have benefited immensely in the last few years.
So it's only logical for Samsung to shift its focus to HBM memory production, as this is the company's best-performing business…
According to inside sources, Samsung is already in talks with its partners, urging them to finish their DDR5 production lines…
